rationale: 3-lens review (blind, edge-case, acceptance) completed on the full diff (6ac0126fe..de391d383). Acceptance audit: all spec criteria pass, 2 dismissed low-severity test-coverage gaps (defer). One confirmed correctness gap blocks: ChatNamingService.rename_conversation only wraps the LLM call in try/except, not the Conversation.find_by_id/update() calls, contradicting the spec's explicit Error handling contract ('every failure mode ... collapses to the same no-op'). Also confirmed (via direct source read, not just lens output): for background_task=True requests, the scheduled naming task never fires because run_assistant_in_thread_pool fire-and-forgets to a separate executor after the request's BackgroundTasks object has already finished running — this is the same gap already called out as a documented 'Known limitation' from an earlier session decision (accepted, deferred), but the doc wording ('may not reliably get the LLM name') understates it as probabilistic when it is actually a guaranteed no-op for that path; recommend wording fix on next touch, not blocking. Blind lens's provider/PII-exposure concern is dismissed — it mirrors the existing CONVERSATION_ANALYSIS_LLM_MODEL precedent, an explicit resolved design decision in the approved spec, not new risk. Blind lens's conversation_id/find_by_id concern is a false positive — request.conversation_id is the client-supplied id already used to construct the new Conversation row, confirmed by reading conversation_service.py directly.

findings.problem: ChatNamingService.rename_conversation wraps only the generate_name() call's failure path via its own internal try/except; the Conversation.find_by_id(conversation_id) and conversation.update() calls after it are unguarded.
findings.impact: An exception from find_by_id/update (e.g. a deleted conversation row, transient DB error) propagates unhandled inside a FastAPI BackgroundTasks callback running after the response was sent — it surfaces only as an unlogged ASGI-level traceback, violating the spec's explicit Error handling contract that 'every failure mode ... collapses to the same no-op.' No test exercises this path.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the find_by_id + update() block in the same try/except Exception -> logger.error(..., exc_info=True) pattern used in generate_name (or wrap the whole rename_conversation body), and add a test where Conversation.find_by_id/update raises.
